```{r}
se_filtered <- function(vals) {
  vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
  mean((vals - mean(vals))^2) / sqrt(length(vals))
}

se <- function(vals) {
  mean((vals - mean(vals))^2) / sqrt(length(vals))
}

mean_filtered <- function(vals) {
  mean(vals[is.finite(vals)])
}

all_results[all_results == -1] = NA

squash_trials <- all_results |>
  group_by(p, algorithm) |>
  # summarise(across(row_group_count:true_err, list(mean=mean, se=se)))
  summarise(across(feature_recall:adjusted.rand_col_true, list(mean=mean_filtered, se=se_filtered)))

row_ari <- ggplot(squash_trials, aes(x=p, y=adjusted.rand_row_mean, color=algorithm)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = adjusted.rand_row_mean - 1.96*adjusted.rand_row_se,
                    ymax = adjusted.rand_row_mean + 1.96*adjusted.rand_row_se)) + 
  labs(y = "Row ARI", x="p") + 
  theme_minimal()
row_ari


col_true_ari <- ggplot(squash_trials,
                       aes(x = p, y = adjusted.rand_col_true_mean, color = algorithm)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = adjusted.rand_col_true_mean - 1.96 * adjusted.rand_col_true_se,
      ymax = adjusted.rand_col_true_mean + 1.96 * adjusted.rand_col_true_se
    )
  ) +
  labs(y = "True Column ARI", x = "p") +
  theme_minimal()
```
